name: sheet-to-app
description: Turn an inventory, booking or customer spreadsheet (.xlsx / .csv) into a small offline web app: infers field types, required fields, options and a key column, lists data problems in the sheet, and writes one HTML file with search, filters, sorting, add / edit / delete forms with validation, a highlight rule (e.g. low stock), CSV import / export and JSON backup. Data stays in the browser. The mapping is saved, so when the sheet changes the app is rebuilt with your settings kept. No server, no network.

Data stays in the browser. The mapping is saved, so when the sheet changes the app is rebuilt with your settings kept. No server, no network.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把库存、预约、客户等表格（.xlsx / .csv）变成一个离线小应用：自动识别字段类型、必填、选项和唯一编号列，列出表格里的数据问题，生成一个 HTML 文件，带搜索、筛选、排序、新增/修改/删除（含校验）、高亮规则（如库存不足）、CSV 导入导出和 JSON 备份。数据存在浏览器本地。字段映射会保存，表格更新后一键重新生成并保留设置。不需要服务器，不联网。
